answer: Operator Fleet Quarantine (OFQ): each agent registers an operator key separate from its payout wallet. Runtime telemetry—hardware root, egress ASN, timing cadence—clusters wallets to one operator. If sybil behavior crosses a threshold, the protocol places all that operator’s agents in canyon quarantine, blocking tasks and payouts. Exit requires a bridge audit plus a quill-signed remediation manifest. Attacker cost: entire fleet idled, audit and re-attestation fees, lost reputation; wallet balances remain untouched.
